name: memory_save
description: Save a standing preference, correction or durable fact to long-term memory, so that later conversations follow it. Use it when the user asks you to remember something or tells you how to work from now on. Tag it with this conversation's user to make it the user's own, with this conversation's project to limit it to the project, with both for this user in this project; leave a tag empty to share it more widely. Pass replaces to rewrite an existing memory instead of adding one. Never save task details or secrets.

content.description: One self-contained sentence of at most 40 words.

user.description: This conversation's user, or empty for every user.

project.description: This conversation's project, or empty for every project.

replaces.description: Id of the memory this one rewrites.

name: memory_forget
description: Delete a memory from long-term memory when it is no longer true or the user asks you to forget it.

id.description: Id of the memory, as listed in long-term memory.
